changes.comment: Corrects the typed-path accessor warning, which promised that an empty path subscribes to "the entire slice". It subscribes to the slice root, which fires only when the slice's whole value is replaced — for an object slice, never. Adds explicit extensions to the relative specifiers of published declaration files. Extensionless relative re-exports do not resolve under `moduleResolution: nodenext`, and because nearly every project sets `skipLibCheck: true` the errors were suppressed while every re-exported symbol silently degraded to `any`.
